name: Arakawa Yui
source:
Very little is known about Yui, because she keeps almost entirely to herself. In studies and school events, she never stands out. Every day, without fail, Yui walks to school alone- then leaves the same way.

[from [url=http://www.shira-oka.com/characters/38-arakawa-yui.html]official site[/url]]
